title: 第21章 衔尾蛇第22章 时间都去哪了
slug: 夫人她只想修仙第370章自爆
content_zh:
那么问题来了。
沈云熠水龙卷将颜筝卷到空中，同时，颜桐也出手了。
偌大的湖面眨眼全结了冰！
“你干什么？快解了冰！
我没法把她运回来了！”
沈云熠焦急道，“快点！
我撑不住多久！”
“她是我妹妹，我会救她，你又为何出手？”
颜桐沉着脸，她完全没想过和颜筝不对付的沈云火熠会出手，便以最决绝，也最有效的方式——冻结整个水面，这样颜筝可以直接爬上来——来解救她。
“靠！
她是我的小师妹，我怎么可能不救她！”
沈云熠骂骂咧咧，哪怕不是颜筝出事，是林端，是她颜桐，再或者是随便哪个北山宗的弟子，他也决计不会坐视不理！
他在颜桐心里到底是个什么形象！
颜桐略感意外地看了他一眼。
“看我干什么！
解冰啊！”
“解不了。”
颜桐冷冷道。
她只有冰灵根，代表她只会结冰，解冰是别人该干的事。
别看他们一聊一想，实际上是短短三、四秒之内发生的事。

而这几秒，也足以改变局势了。
“你！”
沈云熠勃然大怒，接着一愣，暗道不妙，他的控制眨眼消逝。
时间到了！
他瞪大双眼，猛地看向水柱上的颜筝！
他的控制消失了，所谓的水柱自然也不存在了，颜筝伴着晶莹清澈的水珠一齐向下跌。
“哎呦卧糟！”
剧烈疼痛瞬间卷席全身，颜筝的表情扭由在一起，有那么一瞬间，她以为自己摔死了！
水龙卷的高度不高，但也不低，骤然失了支撑，直直到冰面上，伤势可想而知！
幸好这段时间她一直在修炼，吃的餐食里也加了大量本就大补的好东西。
这一摔，还不至于直接送她见阎王，但腿的伤是结结实实落下了，胸腔里又七零八落，她的脸一下子白了。
“筝儿！”
颜桐脚轻轻一点，顺利滑到她面前，一脸关切，“哪里不舒服？”
颜筝脸色难看，手指着腿，一句话都说不出来。
颜桐简单检查了她的脊椎，又仔细看了看她的腿，脊椎没有明曲，腿却有了些许扭曲，至于内脏受得伤，她看不出来。
content_en:
Then here comes the problem.
Chen Yunyi's waterspout swept Yan Zheng into the air, and at the same time, Yan Tong also took action.
The huge lake was completely frozen in the blink of an eye!
"What are you doing? Get off the ice!"
I can't transport her back! "
Shen Yunyi said anxiously, "Hurry up!
I can't hold on much longer! "
"She is my sister, I will save her, why did you take action?"
Yan Tong had a sullen face. She never thought that Shen Yun Huoyi, who was not dealing with Yan Zheng, would take action, so she used the most decisive and effective way - freezing the entire water surface so that Yan Zheng could climb up directly - to rescue her.
"Fuck!
She is my junior sister, how could I not save her! "
Shen Yunyi cursed, even if something happened not to Yan Zheng, but to Lin Duan, to Yan Tong, or to any other disciple of the Beishan Sect, he would never sit idly by and watch!
What image does he have in Yan Tong's mind?
Yan Tong glanced at him slightly surprised.
"Look what I do!
Unice! "
"Can't solve it."
Yan Tong said coldly.
She only has ice spiritual roots, which means she can only freeze, and unblocking ice is what others should do.
Don't look at them chatting and thinking, but it actually happened in just three or four seconds.
And these few seconds are enough to change the situation.
"You!"
Shen Yunyi was furious, then stunned, secretly thinking something was wrong, and his control disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Time is up!
He widened his eyes and looked at Yan Zheng on the water column!
His control disappeared, and the so-called water column naturally disappeared. Yan Zheng fell downwards along with the crystal clear water drops.
"Oh shit!"
Severe pain swept through her whole body instantly, and Yan Zheng's expression twisted together. For a moment, she thought she had fallen to death!
The height of the waterspout was not high, but it was not low either. It suddenly lost its support and fell onto the ice. You can imagine the injuries!
Fortunately, she has been practicing during this period, and the meals she eats also include a lot of good and nourishing things.
This fall would not send her directly to the King of Hell, but the injury to her leg was solid, and her chest was in pieces, and her face suddenly turned pale.
"Zheng'er!"
Yan Tong tapped his foot lightly and slid smoothly in front of her, with a concerned look on his face, "What's wrong with you?"
Yan Zheng looked ugly, pointed at her legs, and couldn't say a word.
Yan Tong briefly checked her spine, and then took a closer look at her legs. There was no obvious bend in the spine, but the legs were slightly twisted. As for the injuries to the internal organs, she could not tell.
